Frame labels
Name a frame so it's easy to find again — like “mouth open” or “impact”.
Tween
New frames go right after this one and move your drawing toward the end pose. The last new frame is the end pose — the faint ghosts on the canvas show the path.

Puppet
Tap the drawing to drop pins, then drag a pin to bend the drawing around it. Pins you don't drag hold that spot still. Add more poses to keep going; Create makes frames after this one that move through the poses. Pins stay until you press Clear.

Contiguous only selects the connected patch of similar color you tap. Turn it off to grab every matching pixel on the layer.

Resolution

Resize canvas keeps every existing pixel exactly where it is — nothing is stretched. Growing it adds transparent space around your art; shrinking it crops away anything that falls outside the new area. Resize project instead stretches or squishes the whole drawing to fill the new size — nothing is cropped, but proportions can change.

Apply this resize?
This will resize the project. Undo history will be cleared.
